question: Does wiring gk_*_simd still help after recon-fuse occupancy tiles deleted the serial bit-walk?
alternating: BASE(HAWKING_Q80_GK_SIMD=0, recon-fuse default on) then OURS(HAWKING_Q80_GK_SIMD=1) per pair, new process each arm

isolated_organs.protocol: warmup=2; 3 alternating BASE(shipping tile) then OURS(gk_*_simd) pairs; GPUEnd-GPUStart
isolated_organs.note_hgravs_R_numeric: Both shipping simd3 and gk_hgravs_simd report max_abs=3.0517578125e-05 against 2e-5. Same number is in Q80_MATVEC_DISCRIMINATOR.json. Pre-existing, not a gk_simd regression.

token_projection_isolated_ms.method: isolated median GPU ns * count per token. Residual up omitted. Not a wall.

why_subsumed: The discriminator 8-45x was gk_*_simd vs serial 1-thread/row bit-walk.
Recon-fuse (merged 9e99870b1) already dispatches occupancy tiles that consume codes in-register: binary tg256 (8 signs/byte), Q8 tg256/simd_bytes (byte load, no bit loop), 3-bit simd3 (8-unpack).
gk_matvec_hgravs_simd still wide-extracts one code per lane, including Q8 (8-bit unpack of a byte). Same 1-SG/row geometry as simd_bytes, worse ALU.
gk_matvec_binary_simd is 1 sign/lane vs shipping tg256 8 signs/lane. 512-row binary gate: 6.9 us -> 28.8 us.
The only isolated ratio > 1.05 is hgravs L 1.057x and the three pair ratios straddle 1.0. Not a win.

shipping_disposition.default: recon-fuse occupancy tiles remain the mixed token path
shipping_disposition.opt_in: HAWKING_Q80_GK_SIMD=1 dispatches gk_matvec_binary_simd / gk_matvec_hgravs_simd. Residual CSR stays on q80_binary_group_csr_matvec_tg256 (no family equivalent).

proposed_negative_science.mechanism: Wire unused gk_*_simd onto the post-reconstruction mixed token path for an 8-45x organ win
proposed_negative_science.what_was_measured: gpu_matvec 36.53 ms -> 91.28 ms (0.40x). Isolated Q8 ba 5.9 us -> 35.5 us; router 7.3 us -> 36.9 us; binary gate 6.9 us -> 28.8 us.
proposed_negative_science.why: The 8-45x was vs the old serial extract. Occupancy+byte tiles already shipped. Family simd is the weaker of the two occupancy geometries and still bit-unpacks Q8.
